name: Speak Ai
description:
Speak AI transcribes and analyzes your interviews, sales calls, research sessions, webinars, podcasts, and team meetings. This connector brings that library into your AI assistant — so instead of scrubbing hours of audio, you just ask.

Capture
- Meeting assistant — send a bot to your Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams calls to record, transcribe, and analyze them. Schedule ahead, drop into a live call, or pull it out whenever.
- Upload anything — audio, video, or text. Get a transcript and AI insights back in the same thread.
- Async surveys — set up voice and video recorders with custom questions, share a link, and collect responses for research, candidate screens, customer feedback, or team check-ins.

Analyze
- Multi-file analysis — search and reason across thousands of recordings at once. Group customer feedback by theme, compare answers across interviews, or pull every mention of a topic with citations back to the source.
- AI chat with your library — ask follow-up questions, save favorite prompts, and keep a full chat history per recording or across your whole workspace.
- Summarize and extract — decisions, action items, owners, risks, sentiment, themes, and exact quotes from any conversation.

Act
- Create — clips, highlights, captions, text notes, folders, custom fields, and embeds, directly from chat.
- Multi-step workflows — chain actions together with automations and webhooks. Auto-tag new recordings, route insights to other tools, trigger follow-ups when a meeting ends, or run a custom prompt against every new upload.

Share & Organize
- Share — export answers, transcripts, captions, and clips. Generate embed links and shareable views to send insights to teammates or stakeholders without giving them access to your whole workspace.
- Organize at scale — bulk move media, update transcripts and speakers, manage folders and views, and clone setups across teams.

Who it's for: researchers, revenue and customer-success teams, meeting-heavy operators, and media and content workflows — anyone who records conversations and wants to stop re-listening to find what matters.

Your recordings stay in your Speak AI workspace. The connector only queries them with the permissions you allow.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (5): `automations-and-webhooks` (Build, test, and operate Speak AI automations and webhooks through MCP), `clips-and-captions` (Turn Speak AI recordings into shareable output), `getting-started` (Connect an agent to Speak AI and orient it in the workspace), `meeting-summaries` (Turn meetings recorded in Speak AI into decisions, action items, owners, and risks), `research-analysis` (Analyze interviews, user research calls, and customer conversations across many Speak AI recordings)
- **MCP servers** (1): `speakai`

Installs with `claude plugin install speak-ai@claude-community` from `speakai/speakai-mcp` (`plugins/speakai-mcp`).
